sp_fix_tank = {
	specialization = specialization_land
	project_tags = sp_tag_tank
	allowed = { }
	available = { FROM = { has_tech = t_c } }
	breakthrough_cost = { specialization_land = 1 }
	resource_cost = { resources = { steel = 4 } }
	prototype_time = sp_time.prototype.short
	complexity = sp_complexity.small
	project_output = {
		country_effects = { set_technology = { t_dlc = 1 popup = no } }
		enable_equipment_modules = { fix_turret_dlc }
	}
}

sp_fix_child = {
	specialization = specialization_land
	special_project_parent = { sp_fix_tank }
	available = { FROM = { has_tech = t_a } }
	prototype_time = sp_time.prototype.short
	complexity = 40
	project_output = { enable_equipments = { light_tank_chassis_2 } }
}

sp_fix_dlc = {
	specialization = specialization_land
	allowed = { has_dlc = "Fixture DLC" }
	prototype_time = sp_time.prototype.short
	project_output = { }
}
